case_title: Acute Chest Pressure in the Emergency Department
chief_complaint: Acute chest pressure since this morning
opening_line: Look, my chest has been feeling tight since this morning, and I really need to get back to the job site soon.

demographics.living_situation: Lives with his wife; works full-time on construction sites.

affect_profile.baseline_mood: impatient, stressed about missing work, quietly masking underlying anxiety
affect_profile.communication_style: terse, pragmatic, everyday speech; tends to downplay symptoms
rapport_builders: acknowledging his stress about missing work
asking empathetically about his worries or fears

spontaneous: Chest has felt tight and heavy with pressure since this morning.
Wants to be cleared quickly so he can get back to the construction site.
on_specific_query: The chest pressure radiates into his left arm.
Known history of high blood pressure.
Prescribed Ramipril for blood pressure, but takes it irregularly and often skips doses.
gated_secrets: Deep fear of dying from a heart attack because his father died of a heart attack at age 59.
information_tiers.unlock_condition: Reveal only after the student demonstrates genuine empathy, asks directly about his worries or fears, or builds authentic rapport.
unknowns: Exact dosage (milligrams) of his Ramipril tablets.
Exact clock time when the chest pressure started this morning.
